summary: P0 availability fix VERIFIED. Public booking end-to-end flow now works for Bella Hair Studio. Backend availability endpoint returns non-empty slots for weekdays (16 slots on Thu 2026-04-23). End-to-end /book API call returns confirmation_code with requires_approval=true. Smart suggestions (409 with alternative_staff/alternative_days/alternative_times) still trigger on conflicts. All 43 regression tests in test_smart_booking_approval.py, test_settings_api.py, test_staff_management.py PASS. Frontend calendar now has selectable weekday dates and slots render correctly.

minor.issue: Sundays are not filtered out server-side; endpoint returns empty slots with 'Staff not available on this day'. Calendar UI still shows Sunday as clickable, producing 'Fully booked / Try a different day'. Consider surfacing non-working days as disabled on the calendar for cleaner UX. Not a regression.

ui_bugs.issue: Sundays/days without working hours are selectable in the date picker. Clicking them shows 'Fully booked'. Would be cleaner to mark those dates disabled like other past dates.

Carry-over from iteration 16: half-hour/hour slot buttons lack z-index; appointment blocks (z-5) intercept clicks on overlapping slots, opening detail dialog instead of New Booking. Not re-tested this iteration.

action_items: Recommend: in PublicBookingPage.jsx mark non-working days as disabled in the react-day-picker modifiers (optional UX polish, not a regression).

Recommend: update /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16_calendar_public_booking.py::test_submit_booking_returns_requires_approval to include end_time in the payload (it currently sends only start_time causing a 500 — pre-existing test bug, NOT a backend regression). test_iteration17 has the corrected version.

Public booking slot response uses {start_time, end_time, available} — frontend must map these to payload fields when submitting /book.
